summary: Feed s061_single to IDS is degraded due to significant packet loss (8.3% of TCP packets, 136/1636) exceeding 1% threshold. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, one-way, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream SPAN/mirror or packet broker is dropping packets under load - 8.3% TCP gaps indicate buffer overflow/oversubscription before the IDS, not IDS overload (tool_overload healthy). SPAN ports drop randomly when ingress exceeds mirror capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS with needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true cannot reassemble TCP streams or match signatures on missing segments; 8.3% loss causes false negatives, broken flow reassembly, and reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP provides lossless, line-rate copy vs SPAN which drops under congestion. Eliminates the 8.3% random loss at source, ensuring IDS receives complete packets for full payload inspection. If TAP already in use, add packet broker with drop-free buffering or filter/slice only non-security traffic.
